cards.text: Absalom, King David's son, has sent for Ahithophel, David's counselor, and his conspiracy keeps gaining strength as the people supporting him increase (2 Samuel 15:12). Now a messenger comes to David with the news: “The hearts of the men of Israel are with Absalom.”
David tells all his servants with him in Jerusalem to get up and flee. The KING of Israel is running out of his OWN city, friend, and he is NOT taking the scenic route.

cards.question: David tells his servants they must leave Jerusalem quickly. What does he say will happen if they don't?

answers.text: Absalom will overtake them and strike the city
The gates will be shut and they'll be trapped
The people will turn on them in the streets

cards.text: His servants answer, “Whatever our lord the king decides, we are your servants.” Friend, I have NEVER gotten a yes that fast in my LIFE.

cards.question: True or false: When David sets out from Jerusalem, his whole household stays behind.
David's household goes with him, but he leaves ten concubines behind to take care of the ___.

cards.text: The king stops at the last house while all his servants march past him: the Cherethites and Pelethites, men under David's command, plus six hundred Gittites who followed him from Gath. Friend, that's not a household moving out, that's a PARADE.

Then David tells Ittai the Gittite, a foreigner and an exile who arrived only yesterday, to go back and stay with the new king. David doesn't even know where he's going himself, and friend, he's not about to drag the new guy along on day two.

cards.question: David gives Ittai the Gittite a way out. What does Ittai say?

answers.text: Wherever the king goes he will be there
He will go back and serve the new king
He will head home and wait for news

cards.question: True or false: When David tells Ittai to march on, Ittai marches past with all his men and the little ones with him.

cards.text: Everyone in the countryside is weeping loudly as all the people pass by. Then the king crosses the Kidron Valley.

cards.question: As the king crosses the Kidron Valley, all the people pass toward the way of the ___.

cards.text: Zadok the priest is there too, with the Levites carrying the ark of the covenant of God, and Abiathar the priest offers sacrifices until all the people have passed out of the city. Then David tells Zadok, “Return the ark of God to the city.”

cards.question: David sends the ark of God back to Jerusalem. What does he say will happen if he finds favor in the eyes of the LORD?

answers.text: The LORD will bring him back to see it again
The LORD will send the ark out to him
The LORD will give him a new city

cards.question: And if the LORD should say He doesn't delight in David? What does David say then?

answers.text: Let the LORD do whatever seems good to Him
He will fight to take back his throne
He will leave Israel and never return

cards.text: David tells Zadok to go back to the city in peace with his son Ahimaaz, and Abiathar with his son Jonathan (not Saul's son), while David waits at the fords of the wilderness. Friend, the fords of the wilderness do NOT come with a waiting room.

cards.question: David will wait at the fords of the wilderness. What is he waiting for?

answers.text: Word from Zadok in the city

cards.text: David keeps going up the Mount of Olives, weeping as he goes. His head is covered, and he's walking barefoot.

cards.question: True or false: The people climbing the Mount of Olives with David cover their heads just like he does.

cards.text: Then someone tells David that Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. That's like finding out the guy who runs your group chat started a brand new one, and you're not in it.

cards.question: Ahithophel has joined Absalom's side. What does David ask the LORD to do?

answers.text: Bring Ahithophel back to David's side
Let Ahithophel fall in the next battle

cards.text: At the summit, where David used to worship God, Hushai the Archite is there to meet him, robe torn and dust on his head. But David tells Hushai, “If you go on with me, you will be a burden to me.”
David has a different job for Hushai. Go back to Jerusalem and tell Absalom, “I will be your servant, my king; in the past I was your father’s servant, but now I will be your servant.”

cards.question: David wants Hushai back in Jerusalem, acting as Absalom's servant. What's the point?

answers.text: To talk Absalom into giving up

cards.question: True or false: David tells Hushai to keep everything he hears in the king's palace a secret from Zadok and Abiathar the priests.
Hushai will pass his news to the priests in Jerusalem. Who carries it out to David?

cards.text: So David's friend Hushai arrives in Jerusalem just as Absalom is entering the city. Talk about cutting it CLOSE, friend, and trust me, this story is nowhere near over.
